description: creationUnlocked fixture (D-GH-2026-08-02-creation-lock-switch): an explicit creationLocked fires, a racial trait is bought at the locked rate, then a creationUnlocked event reopens creation and a second trait is bought. Asserts the unlock is FUTURE-ONLY and never retroactive: 'Halfling: Brave' (bought while locked) keeps its frozen tier-2 locked rate (4), while 'Halfling: Naturally Stealthy' (bought after the unlock) prices at the creation rate (origin=4, not the locked 7). This is the freeze-at-purchase guarantee holding across an unlock.

events.label: Species trait — Halfling: Naturally Stealthy (after unlock, creation rate)
